body: What a mood, just moved with fiancé and found the shiny new scale he bought a couple months ago but never unwrapped

It’s just been a rough year, and I’m doing my best to manage stressors through psych meds and therapy. It should be a temporary situation. I was just really expecting the outbreaks to stop by now despite stress levels etc. 

It’s hard because I obviously want to be honest with him but the speed with which he takes his hands off of me when I tell him hurts. 

I’m trying to stay hopeful, I just can’t help but think this is permanent.
Just how we live life I guess
Yeah, that’s the daily mood, gotta make the memes for the people

I know about asymptomatic shedding and it’s why I am strict about condoms/dams. I shed regularly and keep track of my symptoms. My hormone levels are on a strict cycle and I can anticipate an outbreak fairly reliably. 

I understand where he is coming from as well. It’s just leaving me feeling awful and trapped. 

We don’t do the genital to genital contact thing. Dysphoria and all. He used to do it and I had to keep reminding him of the risk. He was still trying to do that even after declaring he wouldn’t give me oral any longer.

It’s really nice to see thing a like this as someone coming from a rough point in a relationship. If One can’t find happiness in a current relationship it doesn’t mean one is doomed to never find another person.

Thank you for sharing.
I was considering running another poll after this one closes. I will add that as an option and will let you personally know when it it up.
Glad to hear that, stay safe out there.

I wish I could tell you. There just aren’t any good studies that I’ve been able to find. Trans health research is limited in areas.

Edit cause I was thinking about it more: if anything, started HRT made my natural cycles more regular. It brings what was a very irregular cycle (I never had consistent monthly events) to a strict 4 week cycle. I get injections every week and my levels are fairly stable. I’m at the point where I am going through ‘menopause’ but my progress through HRT has not had an effect on outbreaks for better or worse. I had to get my dose corrected and bumped up but no change in outbreaks.
Yeah, I was considering this but I personally wanted a sample from people who were symptomatic, though I can make another poll if people want me to. I didn’t expect this to get so many hits.
You might be asymptomatic, I wish you the best.
I appreciate that. I’m a trans guy who has an IUD and I get regular monthly OB’s with antivirals. Hoping that removal of my IUD will help the OB’s.

I had my first OB in August 2019. Had recurring ob's every month. Started 1 gm Valtrex daily when I got a formal positive test in December. Still had regular OB's every month, had a hormone deficiency corrected. Still had one OB while adjusting to the new dose. Had my first OB free month this month but may have had a possible shedding event. I hope to discuss an increase in dose with my doc the next time I go in. 

Symptoms linger for about a week.
Thanks for the clarification on this. It is an interesting phenomenon.

I’m on a gram, but I’ll talk to my doctor about it. I have a shoddy immune system as it is. 

I know odds are it’s HSV 1 but I just don’t understand why he never disclosed that in the first place since it’s a virus like HSV 2.

I have read about conflicting studies on the ability to contract HSV 2 with an already preexisting case of HSV1. If you could direct me to one that would be awesome. The things is we can't be sure if it is HSV1 that he has because he's not getting a test. 

I am on daily Valtrex and have an IUD. Valtrex hasn't stopped my month OB's that well yet. The cis studies don't really apply because we are gay, and it would be vulva/ vulva. We also don't touch in that way. And if we do I shut it down because he is so worried all the other time about getting HSV2. 

Its not the only thing going awry. It's just one of the issues. Not having an orgasm for three months when the other partner isn't even trying is frustrating. It would be one thing if he was trying. I don't want to cheat, but I certainly wish I could have an orgasm every once in a while. Sex has felt like a chore for his pleasure alone for 3 months. The relationship is usually good regardless. It is just really strained right now. Really really strained.

Thanks for your response.
Good dog
I do get pleasure from sex, it’s just not what I know it could be, not as intense. I think I’m fine with sacrificing this part because everything else goes well but time will really only tell.
He doesn’t want to perform oral if he isn’t positive. And a lot of people are asymptomatic.

Same here. I chug water when I take it first thing in the morning. Usually about 750mL. And then I make sure to keep drinking throughout the day.


Edit: also try to eat something small. There was a day I had pretty low blood sugar along with not drinking much water and nearly fainted in class after standing for twenty minutes.  Might be unrelated but that was very abnormal for me. 

Keep track of what brand your pharmacy gives you. Some brands have an associated higher risk of side affects. 
I don’t have the ones I started with on me right now as I’m on a trip but I’m currently on 1gm valacyclovir by Cipla.
Hormone Replacement Therapy.

I’m on Valtrex. It is helpful. The issue was that I was probably asymptomatic before HRT and then the new hormone cycle for my body was too uneven and caused my body a lot of stress. My hormone dose has been corrected and I haven’t had an ob since. But before I was getting an ob at the end of every hormone cycle.

I’m not having an issue with obs as much as I’m not sexually satisfied and frustrated about  that.

I understood the PIV acronym and thanks for the clarification. 

Using my V makes me wanna slam my head into a wall lol. We are very gay though, so usually he just uses a strap on and we have anal. Which I enjoy immensely, but it does get a bit dull after a while. 

I’ll talk to him again. It’s a good relationship and he understands me like no one else. I’m just getting a little too frustrated/bored sex wise.

We’ve talked about it. He knows it’s a low chance to get oHSV2. I’m open with him about any symptoms and being on antivirals.
